sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • The FOMC will announce its decision today at 14:00 ET, followed by Warsh’s first policy press conference at 14:30. The market is pricing in an approximately 92% probability of a 25bp rate hike to 3.75%-4.00%, which would be the first hike since 2023; in a Reuters survey, 86 of 101 economists are betting on a hike. Warsh has consistently refused to provide forward guidance and prefers a “good family fight” within the committee, making the dot plot and Q&A session the only real sources of information. In Tuesday’s regular session, SPY closed at 757.42 (-0.44%), QQQ at 704.60 (-0.65%), DIA fell 0.62%, and IWM fell 0.95%, with risk assets weakening across the board. As of 07:42 today in premarket trading, SPY was at 757.66 (+0.03%) and QQQ at 705.38 (+0.11%), effectively unchanged—sharply at odds with the comment section’s perception that “everything is green” and “it’s another fake pump.”
  • The 10-year U.S. Treasury yield touched 5.041% intraday Tuesday, its highest level since July 2007, amid a global bond selloff, August CPI of 3.4%, and July PCE of 3.7%. Safe-haven and inflation-hedging assets strengthened simultaneously: GLD closed Tuesday at 394.08 (+0.34%), while TLT closed at 80.715 (-0.29%).
  • Energy remains the real variable in this cycle: Brent crude rose Tuesday to around a four-month high. Saudi Arabia’s East-West pipeline remains offline following an attack, Aramco has provided no timetable for restarting operations and has canceled some September deliveries to European customers, while at least two tankers have been attacked in the Strait of Hormuz in recent days. On Tuesday, USO rose 3.36% to close at 161.89, XLE gained 2.17% to 65.94, and drilling stock RIG surged 8.71% to 5.93.
  • Intel and SK Hynix are reportedly discussing jointly developing memory production capacity in the U.S. Options include SK Hynix leasing space at Intel’s Ohio site or forming a joint venture with a cloud provider. The report gained traction overnight. INTC closed Tuesday’s regular session at 97.12 (-0.02%). The community claims it was up around 4%-5% premarket, but as of 07:42, the local market data source had yet to show a valid premarket transaction price.
  • The CLARITY crypto market structure bill failed in the Senate by a 49-50 vote, with the procedural vote falling far short of the 60-vote threshold. Bitcoin dropped below $76,000, while COIN plunged 10.10% Tuesday to close at 172.05, making it one of the worst-performing large-cap stocks of the day.
  • AI “extinction” warnings are openly clashing with the compute camp: Several Anthropic researchers publicly stated that AI models could cause human extinction within this decade, while Jensen Huang, appearing alongside Trump, firmly opposed slowing AI development, with Zuckerberg also joining the rebuttal. NVDA rose 0.55% Tuesday to close at 212.17, while ORCL dropped 3.02% to 140.315, highlighting growing divergence within the AI trade.

社区氛围：整体情绪是一种“不情愿的乐观加上强烈的自我怀疑”。大多数参与者都接受这样的说法：“25 个基点已经被定价，因此一旦发生，股市就会反弹”，但几乎没有人愿意真正持有大量头寸。现金持有者和“等待沃什讲话”阵营异常突出，评论部分将所有赌注押在 14:30 的措辞上，而不是利率决定本身。

恐惧/贪婪程度：大约40/100，恐惧但不极端。证据是矛盾的：一方面，0DTE IV 被公开批评为“太贵了”，一些用户表示他们已经清算了头寸或者“96% 是现金”，还有一个人将他们的 401k 完全转为现金。另一方面，诸如“空头已经灭绝”和“加息是最乐观的事情”等讽刺性帖子却获得了大量支持。真正的恐惧集中在能源和债券而不是股票本身。

WSB 情绪与实际价格走势：明显背离。尽管指数 ETF 的实际盘前波动低于 0.15%，但社区反复描述“疯狂的盘前上涨”和“一切都是绿色的”。同样，社区将 INTC 描绘成一枚火箭，尽管它在周二的例行交易中基本持平。这种将隔夜小幅波动夸大为完整叙述的倾向本身就是事件前流动性耗尽和普遍不愿下注的迹象。
